verdict.rationale: The only AI-assistant evidence is contextual help with Paxos APIs, built into the documentation site. Nothing shows an assistant inside the Paxos platform or Dashboard that users can delegate tasks to, such as running transfers, onboarding or conversions. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are building blocks for external AI tools, not a built-in assistant, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Get contextual help with Paxos APIs using AI assistance built into our documentation.
